title: Chapter 1191 - 11 Chaos Taiji (Seeking Subscription) _2

Chapter 1191 - 11 Chaos Taiji (Seeking Subscription) _2

Chapter 1191: Chapter 11 Chaos Taiji (Seeking Subscription) _2

Therefore, it was finally named ’Infinite Eye’.

And the Infinite Crystal, by refining a certain number of Infinite Crystals, can transform one’s physique towards the Infinite Divine Body.

The Infinite Divine Body, as one of the top divine bodies of the Six Ancient Countries, though not as skilled in attack and destruction as the Fierce Sun Divine Body, can nonetheless encompass other divine bodies.

Simply put, you can simultaneously possess the Infinite Divine Body and other divine bodies.

Thus, the Infinite Crystal is very popular among the powerful figures of the Six Ancient Countries, and no one would refuse an additional top-tier divine body, as it means a substantial increase in combat power.

"The precious lands nurtured by this source world are greatly beneficial for cultivation and the evolution of life, especially the top-tier precious lands."

"The wars between the Six Ancient Countries, with continuous expansion and contraction, are largely due to the contest for these precious lands."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

After all, precious lands cannot be moved; as long as a particular ancient country rules over this region, it naturally gains ownership of the precious land.

For instance, if one day a battlefield arises between Xuanyin Ancient Country and Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and Fierce Sun Ancient Country is defeated, Xuanyin Ancient Country will capture the region where the Hei Yu Nest is located.

Then the Hei Yu Nest would belong to Xuanyin Ancient Country, and Lin Yuan, the guardian, would have to withdraw.

Furthermore, before withdrawing, they can take all the Hei Yu at most, but as for the Hei Yu Nest, this precious land? It must not be destroyed, which is also the iron law between the Six Ancient Countries.

No matter what level of precious land it is, destruction is not allowed, otherwise one would be hunted by all the strong figures of the Six Ancient Countries.

...

Returning to the residence.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, beginning to delve deeply into understanding the inheritance of "Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos."

"Only one million and eight hundred thousand merits, and I am able to exchange for such a level of inheritance. My luck is truly not bad."

The more Lin Yuan contemplated, the more significant his gains felt.

The creator of the inheritance considered the Fierce Sun Xuanyin bloodline, and coupled with the Chaos Power’s rule of evolution path, it became Fierce Sun. By understanding Xuanyin, comprehensive studies of the combination and complement of the two paths were conducted.

Although Fierce Sun, Xuanyin are different from Taiyang, Taiyin, they have many similarities, and the creator of the inheritance has comprehended both Chaos Intense Sun and Chaos Xuanyin to the third level, already involving the perfect fusion of the two.

"Xuanyin..."

Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand, and strands of extremely yin power began to entangle, clashing with the surrounding environment filled with Fierce Sun’s Origin Source.

By killing Beiyin Venerable Sage and Jihan Venerate, many Xuanyin inheritances were obtained, plus the expenditure of one million and eight hundred thousand merits exchanged for the "Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos" inheritance.

This caused Lin Yuan’s understanding on the path of Xuanyin to progress rapidly.

"I can feel it..."

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, consciousness descending into his inner universe.

The inner universe of the true body of the source world is vast, not as expansive as the Chaos Void, but still measured in billions of light-years.

And at the highest point of the inner universe, many Dao rules converge here, forming an egg-like shape, surrounded by swirling Chaos Qi, faintly nurturing and evolving something.

After Lin Yuan’s insight into the Chaos Rule reached the pinnacle of the Second Realm, he began to attempt the evolution of the Chaotic Taiji Dao, ultimately forming the scene before his eyes.

The egg enveloped by Chaos Qi is the final Tao Fruit of Lin Yuan’s insight into the Chaos Rule, while that which is being nurtured and evolved inside is the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Power.

"Understanding the path of Xuanyin has caused a qualitative change in my perception of the Chaos Taiyin Taiyang Taiji, the path of such chaos power... can evolve within at most ten thousand years."

Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened.

Prior to this, even with perception of the Chaos Rule at the Second Realm, Lin Yuan could only feel it was evolving, as to when it could evolve, that remained unclear.

But now, Lin Yuan felt the specific evolution timeline.

Ten thousand years.

At most, ten thousand years to evolve the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji.

"It seems understanding Xuanyin and compensating on the Taiyin path was correct."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the Taiji Dao formed by Taiyang and Taiyin can complement each other perfectly, Taiyang transforming into Taiyin if lacking, and Taiyin transforming into Taiyang if lacking.

But the Taiyin Taiyang after mutual transformations ultimately is not as good as what I truly comprehend, Lin Yuan’s perception in Taiyin is not up to par with Taiyang.

"Next, continuing to understand Xuanyin will accelerate the evolution of Chaos Taiji."

Lin Yuan thought, the Chaotic Taiji Dao is my exclusive path, and in the Chaos Void, this is the distinction between an ordinary lord and a Great Saint.

"Only understanding Xuanyin?"

Lin Yuan’s brows furrowed slightly: "Based solely on this inheritance, understanding the true Xuanyin Dao is still too slow."

In the "Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos" inheritance, the exposition on the Xuanyin path is merely the creator’s own understanding, which indeed provided significant guidance to Lin Yuan.

However, utilizing this to comprehend the true Xuanyin Dao is still somewhat lacking.

"The creator of this legacy walked the path of understanding the Xuanyin Dao by delving into the depths of their own bloodline’s Xuanyin roots, I can do the same."

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

Although he didn’t possess the Xuanyin bloodline, within the countless beings of the Ancient Xuanyin Country, the Xuanyin bloodline flowed through them all.

Lin Yuan couldn’t comprehend his own, but couldn’t he comprehend others’?

...

Ancient Xuanyin Country, Dragon Frost Domain.

The Dragon Frost Domain is the fiefdom of Long Shuang, a peak Great Lord of the Ancient Xuanyin Country with a notable reputation, who once dominated the southwestern region of the Ancient Xuanyin Country.

"How should I progress further and step into the rank of the Heavenly Venerate?" Long Shuang was in seclusion, contemplating his future path.

For beings outside the royal family, truly becoming part of the upper echelon of the Ancient Country and competing with the royals and core royals for power only happens upon reaching the Heavenly Venerate level.

For instance, in the treasuries of various Ancient Countries, the exchangeable rare legacies require a vast amount of merit, which the typical Great Lord cannot hope to accumulate.

Heavenly Venerates can gather merit because they usually preside over treasure grounds, receiving merit from doing so, and over a long, enduring period, they can amass a sizeable amount of merit.

Then suddenly—

Long Shuang’s expression changed dramatically. He suddenly sensed the time and space around him slightly distorted, like a lens being cut away, severing all contact with the outside world.

Whoosh!

A figure stepped out from the void, quietly overlooking Long Shuang below.

"Greetings, my lord."

Long Shuang was startled and immediately rose to bow.

Being able to easily sever his time and space from the outside signifies that his life and death were now entirely in the hands of the other party, with no thought of resistance in Long Shuang’s mind.

"Give me five drops of vital blood, vital blood."

Lin Yuan gazed down at Long Shuang, speaking.

Long Shuang, as a peak Great Lord, should have a high concentration of Xuanyin blood within him. Lin Yuan could fully comprehend and thereby understand the true Xuanyin Dao.

Whether it’s the Xuanyin bloodline or the Fierce Sun bloodline, or the Da Ling bloodline, all are passed down from their thirteenth-rank ancestors, containing fragments of the true thirteenth-rank Dao.

"Yes."

Long Shuang was very compliant, offering no resistance and directly extracting five drops of vital blood.

What is termed vital blood is the most important blood of a being, and even a Great Lord doesn’t have much of it within their body.

"Remember, do not extinguish these five drops of vital blood."

Lin Yuan took the vital blood, glanced at Long Shuang, and said casually.

At the twelfth level of life, there is absolute control over every part of the body, allowing one to extinguish it with a thought.

The five drops of vital blood that Long Shuang handed over, even if they fell into Lin Yuan’s hands, could still be extinguished with a thought from Long Shuang afterward.

Just like extinguishing one’s flesh and soul, Lin Yuan couldn’t stop it.

Unless he completely destroyed the other party’s mind and will, rendering the physical body into an ownerless object.

"Alright."

Long Shuang trembled inside, immediately nodding.

The next moment.

Long Shuang sensed the restoration of time and space, once again feeling everything external to him.

"Just now..." Long Shuang steadied himself. Had he not lost five drops of vital blood, he might have thought his recent experience was a hallucination.

"That powerful being?"

Long Shuang thought of the powerful being who had appeared just before, in whose presence he had completely lost control over time and space, as if a mere ant before a giant.

"Heavenly Venerate, definitely of the Heavenly Venerate level."

Long Shuang swallowed hard; at this moment, he faintly sensed that his five drops of vital blood had already been taken far away, yet could not pinpoint their exact location.

"Why does such a powerful being need my vital blood?"

Long Shuang wondered within but dared not attempt to actively extinguish those five drops of vital blood.

Indeed, he had the ability to extinguish his own vital blood, even once it had left his body.

But then what?

If he provoked that mysterious Heavenly Venerate, it would be no harder for the other to return and crush him than to crush an ant.
